verdict.rationale: Sprinto is a compliance automation SaaS with embedded AI features (AI Editor, AI evidence gap analysis, AI-assisted due diligence), so letting users attach MCP servers to extend its AI is a fair question. The evidence pack has nothing showing it can act as an MCP client. Its native integrations (Jira, ClickUp, JumpCloud), inbound webhooks, and the compliance-skills repo of skills for external coding agents are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit here.
